name: Dave Prowse
title: Director, Developer Security
tagline: Strategic cybersecurity executive building security platforms, teams, and AI-driven defences at global scale.
statement: Strategic cybersecurity executive with a proven track record of **transforming security organisations and embedding security at scale**. At Electronic Arts, I lead Developer Security: the products, platforms, automation, and **DevSecOps** capabilities that enable thousands of developers to ship secure games and software to 700 million players without friction.

I specialise in building high-impact security teams, creating scalable security platforms, and driving executive-level security strategy in global technology firms. More recently, my focus has expanded into **applying agentic AI and adversarial multi-agent approaches to security**: embedding security directly into developer workflows and evolving vulnerability discovery beyond traditional techniques.

My leadership philosophy centres on aligning security with business objectives, leveraging automation and emerging technologies to drive efficiency, and fostering a culture where security is an enabler, not an obstacle.

roles.title: Director, Developer Security
roleHistory: Director, Security Software Engineering · Jun 2024 – Jun 2026
Senior Manager, Security Automation · Jan 2022 – Jun 2024
bullets: Lead **Developer Security** at Electronic Arts, responsible for the security products, platforms, automation, and **DevSecOps** capabilities that secure software development across EA and protect the integrity of its games and player ecosystems.
Hold an enterprise-wide developer security remit, partnering directly with security and engineering leadership on strategy, priorities, and investment.

Direct a portfolio spanning developer-facing security platforms, secure development tooling, security reporting and visibility solutions, AI-assisted security capabilities, and gameplay integrity operations tooling used by anti-cheat teams across EA.
Set the team's mission around making security **easier to consume**, through considered product design, workflow integration, and automation.
Embed security directly into developer and operational workflows, reducing friction while improving visibility, actionability, and security outcomes at scale.

Architected and executed EA's **developer-first security strategy**, embedding security seamlessly into the development lifecycle for thousands of engineers. Advocated security-by-design principles while ensuring security tools were frictionless, fast, and aligned with developer needs.

Conceptualised, developed, and launched @@Talos@@, EA's enterprise-wide security scanning platform providing comprehensive automation across secrets, IaC, SAST, SBOM, licence compliance, and related domains. Fully integrated into CI/CD pipelines, delivering real-time visibility into security posture.

Built @@Dashy@@, EA's gameplay integrity analysis platform, in close partnership with EA Javelin Anticheat. Aggregates telemetry, gameplay statistics, and machine learning models to identify and act on disruptive player behaviour at scale.

Led development of @@Pallas@@, an agentic AI security platform providing signed and verifiable security guidance to developers using tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and Windsurf. Delivers context-aware, always-on guidance via lightweight integration points (e.g. CLAUDE.md) alongside on-demand pre-flight checks and automated validation.

Designed and built @@Zipline@@, an adversarial security scanning harness leveraging teams of AI agents to analyse, build, and exploit applications. Implements a multi-stage **FIND → VERIFY → CRITIQUE → JUDGE** loop to simulate real-world attacker behaviour and uncover high-impact vulnerabilities.

Built @@EA Guardians@@, a gamified security awareness and training platform used by every full-time employee. Designed to make security education engaging through interactive learning and real-world scenarios.
Developed EA Security's @@Docs Portal@@, a centralised repository for partner-facing security documentation, improving accessibility and reducing friction in compliance and security engagement.

Launched the @@EA Security Portal@@, a single pane of glass for security tooling, governance, and engagement. Hosts engagement workflows, artefact collection, cheat reporting, and self-service security capabilities.
Drove executive-level security strategy, working closely with C-suite leadership, game studio executives, and engineering VPs to align security initiatives with business goals.
Scaled EA's security software engineering function, recruiting and mentoring high-performing engineers while fostering a culture of innovation and technical excellence.

roles.title: Senior Security Consultant, AWS ProServe, Global Strategic Accounts
bullets: Worked within AWS's elite Global Strategic Accounts practice, delivering high-impact security transformations for Amazon's top 20 global customers: Fortune 50 companies across healthcare, semiconductor, automotive, and financial services.

Led a security risk assessment for **AstraZeneca** in the context of developing COVID-19 vaccines. Assessed their threat landscape against nation-state attackers, providing bespoke recommendations to protect high-value research and vaccine production infrastructure from cyber espionage and IP theft.

Served as the security **'Bar Raiser'** for a hyperscale cloud migration on behalf of **Arm**, securing high-performance compute environments used for system-on-chip (SoC) design. Designed governance frameworks, threat models, and cloud-native security controls.

Led security strategy for **Mercedes-Benz's** global AWS platform, ensuring mission-critical vehicle sales and backend systems met AWS security best practices. Defined governance, logging and alerting, incident response, data protection, and network security at scale.
Partnered directly with CISO-level executives to define long-term cloud security roadmaps, ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements, risk management strategies, and business growth objectives.
Acted as a mentor and leader within AWS's Security Area of Depth Programme, training AWS consultants in cloud security best practices and real-world threat modelling.

roles.title: Global Director, Product, Automotive and Manufacturing Security
roleHistory: Head of Security Architecture · Aug 2018 – Mar 2019
IT Security Architect Team Leader · Feb 2016 – Aug 2016
bullets: Relocated to **Singapore** on international assignment to create Dyson's global manufacturing cybersecurity **centre of excellence**.

Owned cybersecurity and manufacturing security for Dyson's **connected electric vehicle programme**, standing up security for an entirely new product category from scratch, until the programme was cancelled in 2019.

Appointed **Interim CISO**, leading enterprise-wide security strategy, board-level reporting, and security governance across Dyson's global operations, then continued as **Deputy CISO and Product CISO**.
Held accountability for product cybersecurity architecture and consultancy across embedded software, mobile applications, and cloud infrastructure.
Owned manufacturing cybersecurity across **OT, IoT, and ICS** environments, covering both Dyson-operated facilities and contract manufacturers.
Ran offensive security, spanning penetration testing, red team, and application security testing.

Built Dyson's Security Architecture function from the ground up, scaling from a single security architect to a multi-team department covering security engineering, product security, and offensive security.
Designed security controls for Dyson's IoT and Connected Home products, navigating complex regulatory requirements and security challenges.
Oversaw security governance and maturity development using **NIST CSF and BSIMM**, aligning Dyson's security posture with recognised international standards.
Implemented **NIST SP 800-82 (Rev. 3)** for operational technology environments and embedded **NIST 800-53** controls into enterprise and product security practices.

Led security transformation initiatives, including a cloud security transformation and initiatives that enabled future-of-work and remote working capabilities. This work proved critical in ensuring business continuity during the COVID-19 pandemic.
Launched Dyson's **Bug Bounty Programme**, improving product security and vulnerability management across consumer devices.

roles.title: Network Technical Architect
roles.summary: Led security architecture for UK government and critical national infrastructure clients. Delivered large-scale data centre security transformations and complex network security upgrades.

roles.title: Senior Network and Security Engineer
roles.summary: Provided technical leadership in network security, resolving critical incidents and implementing best-practice configurations. Led continuous service improvement initiatives.

roles.title: Principal Network Engineer
roles.summary: Designed and maintained Symantec.cloud's global security scanning infrastructure. Led network security strategy, risk management, and incident response.

roles.title: Core Services Engineer
roles.summary: Advanced troubleshooting and 3rd-line support for network and security solutions at a UK-based ISP.

beyond: Most of my spare time goes on things I don't need to build: automations, small tools, and whatever new language or AI toy has caught my attention. Away from a keyboard, there are board games, video games, tabletop RPGs, LEGO, craft beer and terrible science fiction, though not necessarily in that order.

I play saxophones in several big bands around the South West and try to see at least as much live music as I perform. I'll happily argue about the NFL, Rugby Union or Formula 1 from the safety of an armchair. I also love travelling and cooking, particularly the food of South East Asia, having spent two years living in Singapore. I make a mean Gong Bao chicken.
I live in the UK with my wife and our two children.
